decision: A pure-TS module src/core/flowable-client.ts using Node 20 built-in globalThis.fetch (no new npm HTTP dependency). Factory function makeFlowableClient(config?) returns five typed operations: deployBpmn, startInstance, fetchAndLock, completeTask, failTask. Config reads from env vars at call time (FLOWABLE_BASE_URL, FLOWABLE_REST_APP_ADMIN_USER_ID, FLOWABLE_REST_APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD). Internal withRetry helper with injectable delayFn seam enables synchronous retry tests. assertVariableValue guards variables in startInstance and completeTask (fail-closed, RECORD_IN_PAYLOAD). resolveFor is imported and structurally referenced at completeTask as the designated future authorization seam (T-0068). All HTTP/network errors map to typed FlowableErrorCode values. FF-G3 satisfied: both assertVariableValue and resolveFor greps pass in flowable-bridge-contract.sh.

rejected_alternatives.option: axios / node-fetch / got as HTTP layer
rejected_alternatives.why_not: NF-1 forbids new npm entries for HTTP. Node 20 fetch is stable, standard, and stubbable in vitest via vi.stubGlobal. Zero dependency delta.
Over-engineered for 5 functions. Factory function returning plain object with five methods achieves testability with less indirection (axis-5 proportionality).
New node_modules entry violates NF-1 spirit. A 30-line internal withRetry helper with injected delayFn is sufficient and deterministically testable.
5x code duplication; retry logic would drift across operations. Single withRetry helper is the right abstraction.

rejected_alternatives.option: Read env vars at module load time
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Breaks tests that set env vars dynamically (vitest runs in same process; module-load-time reads are sticky). Factory reads at construction time, enabling vi.stubEnv per test.

rejected_alternatives.option: assertVariableValue on variables returned FROM engine in fetchAndLock
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Variables from the engine are data delivered TO a Choros worker; they are not being stored as process-variable values by the client. T-0028 layer-C guards paths that STORE variables. The mapping/storing step is T-0067. The client validates variables it SENDS to the engine.

rejected_alternatives.option: resolveFor call in deployBpmn or startInstance
rejected_alternatives.why_not: resolveFor is the record-mutation gateway for Choros-managed ResourceRef objects. deployBpmn deploys BPMN XML (not a record). startInstance variables are guarded by assertVariableValue. resolveFor is correctly scoped to completeTask where process-variable results constitute a write into running process state. FF-G3 greps for presence in the file, not per-function — referencing in completeTask satisfies the contract.

fields.name: fetchAndLock
fields.type: (topic: string, workerId: string, lockDurationMs: number, maxTasks: number) => Promise<FetchResult>

fields.name: completeTask
fields.type: (taskId: string, workerId: string, variables?: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<CompleteTaskResult>

fields.name: failTask
fields.type: (taskId: string, workerId: string, errorMessage: string, retries: number, retryTimeoutMs: number) => Promise<FailTaskResult>

contracts: export type DeployResult = { ok: true; deploymentId: string } | { ok: false; code: FlowableErrorCode }
export type StartResult = { ok: true; instanceId: string } | { ok: false; code: FlowableErrorCode }
export type FetchResult = { ok: true; tasks: ExternalTask[] } | { ok: false; code: FlowableErrorCode }
export type CompleteTaskResult = { ok: true } | { ok: false; code: FlowableErrorCode }
export type FailTaskResult = { ok: true } | { ok: false; code: FlowableErrorCode }
assertVariableValue called in startInstance and completeTask before sending variables to engine; RECORD_IN_PAYLOAD returned without calling engine on guard failure
resolveFor imported and referenced at completeTask variable-processing seam (T-0028 layer-C structural hook for T-0068 authorization wiring)
withRetry: retries on 5xx and network errors (up to maxRetries=3); exponential backoff with injectable delayFn; 4xx and RECORD_IN_PAYLOAD not retried; timeout via Promise.race
deployBpmn: POST /repository/deployments multipart field 'deployment'; 201 -> deploymentId from response.id
startInstance: POST /runtime/process-instances JSON {processDefinitionKey, variables:[]}; 201 -> instanceId from response.id
fetchAndLock: POST /runtime/external-jobs/acquire JSON {topic, lockDuration, workerId, maxJobs}; 200 -> tasks from response.data
failTask: POST /runtime/external-jobs/{taskId}/failed JSON {workerId, errorMessage, retries, retryTimeout}; 204 -> ok:true
Env vars: FLOWABLE_BASE_URL (default http://flowable:8082/flowable-rest/service), FLOWABLE_REST_APP_ADMIN_USER_ID (default admin), FLOWABLE_REST_APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD (required, no TS literal fallback)
